name: Hairy Jack

attributes.attribute: British folkloric spirit in the form of a Black Dog
hunted wild places of the Lincolnshire region
could turn into a little lame man to pass unseen

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Hairy Jack is a British folkloric spirit. He is a Black Dog from the Lincolnshire region. He haunted wild places in the area. He could turn himself into a little lame man to pass unnoticed among the neighbors.
objective: Document Hairy Jack, the Lincolnshire Black Dog of British folklore.
